releaseName: Lokify v1.3.7 – Google Play Protect Safe Release
releaseNotes:
• Google Play Protect Security Fix: Removed high-risk REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES and legacy storage permissions that trigger 'Harmful App' warnings.
• Enforced TLS/HTTPS: Configured strict networkSecurityConfig with cleartextTraffic disabled.
• Disabled remote webContentsDebugging in release builds.
• Enabled APK Signature Scheme v1, v2, and v3.
